title: Pottery Palettes
description: Pottery sherds can now be dyed into multiple colors.
body:
Minecraft 26.3 snapshot 1 gave us data driven pottery sherds! Now, you can dye your pottery sherd with any of the 16 dyes and craft your own colorful decorative pot.

![Decorative pots with new data driven pottery sherds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f478b767bf736bf5bab55bc7a27ee9228deb8a6b.png)

Besides dying sherds, this data pack gives players 4 new pottery patterns from Minecraft Dungeons which can be found as trail ruin rare archeology loot. 

Bake bricks into cracked sherds and barter with piglins to receive a rare gold joined pottery sherd to build decorative pots into something similar to traditional Japanese kintsugi.

Trade with the wandering trader for a rare sherd.

Enable the [Pottery Palettes resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pottery-palettes-resource-pack) by Mickey Joe [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pottery-palettes-resource-pack).
